source.name: v2-low-rounded
source.instruction: A mature British male bedtime narrator. Low, rounded, velvety baritone with a gentle Southern English accent. Speak slowly and softly, with almost level intonation and relaxed pauses. Intimate and slightly breathy, with smooth gentle consonants. No gravel, rasp, theatrical projection or sharp sibilance. Warm, understated late-night storytelling, not whispering.

note: Independent VoiceDesign clips: same direction/seed, but text changes can change identity and delivery. No V6 cleanup. No pronunciation success assumed.
